positions.name: Bitcoin
positions.catalyst: DAY TWENTY-FOUR. HOLD BTC (closed and re-bought at the same canonical print). Risk-off continued for a third day: hawkish Fed minutes kept another hike in play, oil stayed elevated, and roughly $550-650M of longs were liquidated. BTC has fallen about 4.2% from the Oct 6 high near 86.6K. No coin on the nine-name board has a catalyst strong enough to justify alt-beta into this tape. BTC passed yesterday's hold test: it ranks top three since the last run (-1.40%, behind ETH -1.19% and level with ADA -1.51%), while SOL, XRP and LINK each fell about 3%. It is also still above the 82K daily invalidation line. The setup is asymmetric if 82K holds: the stop is defined and the rebound target is 84K, then 86-87.4K.

WHY BTC AGAIN: it is the defensive major on a low-edge, risk-off day, and the drawdown is orderly. A 7-day change of only about -0.25% shows this is a give-back of the Oct 6 pop, not a breakdown.

RUNNERS-UP (move since yesterday's run): ETH 2,549.05 (-1.19%). Its relative strength is slightly better, but it had ~$202M of ETF outflows on Oct 6 and is still below the lost 2,650 line, which leaves no clean stop. SOL 114.26 (-2.8%) is high beta into a macro tape. XRP 1.4004 (-3.4%) and LINK 13.038 (-3.2%) are making fresh lows. ADA 0.25116, DOGE 0.08724, AVAX 10.723 and LTC 64.293 have no catalyst.

PRICE NOTE: canonical proxy with a cache-buster; asOf 10:50:38Z, about 2s after run time. The CoinDesk 6:43am EDT reference of ~82,631 matches. Search used for narrative only. positions.risks:
BTC is sitting right on the 82K support. A daily close below it opens 80K and a liquidation cascade. Further risks: hawkish Fed repricing ahead of the Oct 27-28 FOMC, oil/Middle East escalation, and continued ETF outflows (CoinDesk's -$485M print would be the largest since June).

FRICTION: the Robinhood spread is not charged by the paper book.

TEST FOR TOMORROW: hold BTC only if it is TOP-THREE on the nine-name board OR reclaims 84,000. STRUCTURAL INVALIDATION: daily loss of 82,000 (rotate to the strongest major or a clean RS leader). Hard stop 76,014.05 (-8%).
